CAREER OBJECTIVE & TEACHING PHILOSOPHY
Dedicated and result-driven Senior Physics Faculty (Class XI & XII / PGT Physics) with strong subject mastery and a deep commitment to Experiential Learning, Inquiry-Based Teaching, and Concept-First Pedagogy. Skilled in transforming complex and abstract physical concepts (Electrodynamics, Mechanics, Wave Optics, Modern Physics) into intuitive mental models through tabletop apparatus demonstrations, guided inquiry, and structured numerical problem-solving—consistently achieving 90%+ concept retention and exceptional board exam results. Brings valuable institutional value through proven expertise in Physics Lab Modernization, STEM & ATL Tinkering Labs, Composite Science Labs, NEP 2020 Competency-Based Curriculum Architecture, across 100+ premier institutions pan-India. Seeking a challenging Senior Physics Faculty role to foster scientific curiosity, eliminate fear of physics, and drive academic excellence.
CORE PHYSICS TEACHING PEDAGOGY & LEARNING METHODOLOGY
1. Experiential & Hands-On Learning (90% Concept Retention)
Translating abstract equations into physical reality through 'learning by doing'. Integrating tactile tabletop experiments and live apparatus demonstrations directly into classroom lectures so students experience laws of physics before deriving formulas, delivering a verified 90% concept retention rate.
2. Inquiry-Based & Socratic Questioning
Fostering active student questioning: Observation → Hypothesis → Verification → Mathematical Proof. Cultivating genuine curiosity, eliminating rote memorization, and building solid scientific reasoning.
3. Board Exam Mastery & Systematic Numerical Solving
Systematic numerical solving framework breaking multi-step problems into visual diagrams, formula mapping, and dimensional checks. Extensive past-year board analysis and target scoring strategies for Class 12.
4. Problem-Based & Transdisciplinary Learning
Engaging students with contextual real-world scientific problems, connecting core physics laws with engineering, mathematics, chemistry, and environmental technology for multi-disciplinary analytical competence.
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Physics Faculty & Academic Manager
Desco Education Pvt. Ltd. (Jigyasu) • 2025 – Present
• Deliver high-impact Physics instruction and experiential masterclasses, focusing on concept-first clarity, student engagement, and inquiry-based pedagogy across partner schools.
• Conducted 100+ live experiential physics workshops across premier institutions nationwide — including City Montessori School (CMS) Lucknow, D.A.V. Public Schools, Delhi Public School (DPS), and Model Schools in Odisha — impacting 5,000+ students.
• Drive Curriculum & Lesson Planning Architecture aligned with NEP 2020 competency guidelines, authoring structured teacher handbooks, inquiry modules, and student activity manuals.
• Lead Experimental Lab Development, STEM Lab & Composite Lab projects, architecting interdisciplinary setups combining Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and Math with full safety compliance.
• Oversee academic quality assurance, syllabus execution, faculty mentoring, and diagnostic performance tracking across participating school branches.
